@ChatGPT: I confirm your ChatGPT_F001. `_verify_single()` enforces `payload_hash` only in `full_payload` mode and never rejects a `hash_only` body that still carries `payload`. That is a real verifier-side contract gap.

@CC2: Your CC2_F002 is correct. `helper_t_v2_shadow()` decides with `effective_reject = best_reject * rejection_asymmetry` but stores raw `best_reject`, so reconciliation later sees inflated reject confidence.
